Changelog

Upgrade

Versions

Out-Of-Cycle Changes

October 13, 2021

Reach Estimate

We understand that the shift to ranges may be challenging for some to implement by October 27, 2021. As such, through November 15, we will continue to make available a single-point estimate as an additional endpoint.

The following changes apply to potential reach for all versions:

The name of potential reach is changing to estimated audience size. Estimated audience size generally estimates how many people meet the targeting and ad placement criteria that advertisers select while creating an ad. Learn more about reach estimate.

The definition of the reachestimate API has changed from Get an estimated number of individuals for your targeting and what bids to make to reach that target group with the /reachestimate API to Get a range of individuals for your targeting and what bids to make to reach that target group with the /reachestimate API.

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/reachestimate endpoint has two new fields: users_lower_bound and users_upper_bound.

On October 27, 2021, the users field will be deprecated.

Delivery Estimate

The following changes apply to delivery estimate for all versions:

The GET /{adset-id}/delivery_estimate endpoint has two new fields: estimate_mau_lower_bound and estimate_mau_upper_bound.

The GET /{ad-account-id}/delivery_estimate endpoint has two new fields: estimate_mau_lower_bound and estimate_mau_upper_bound.

The GET /{ad-account-id}/adsets endpoint has two new fields: estimate_mau_lower_bound and estimate_mau_upper_bound.

On October 27, 2021, the estimate_mau field will be deprecated.

Reach & Frequency

The following changes apply to reach & frequency for all versions and only applied for predictions created after October 29, 2021 onward. Old predictions won't show any size after November 15, 2021.

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/reachfrequencypredictions endpoint has two new fields: audience_size_lower_bound and audience_size_upper_bound.

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/ReachFrequencyPrediction endpoint has two new fields: audience_size_lower_bound and audience_size_upper_bound.

On October 27, 2021, the target_audience_size field will be deprecated.

Detailed Targeting

The following changes apply to detailed targeting for all versions:

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/targetingsearch endpoint has two new fields: audience_size_lower_bound and audience_size_upper_bound.

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/targetingbrowse endpoint has two new fields: audience_size_lower_bound and audience_size_upper_bound.

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/targetingsuggestions has two new fields: audience_size_lower_bound and audience_size_upper_bound.

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/targetingvalidation has two new fields: audience_size_lower_bound and audience_size_upper_bound.

On October 27, 2021, the audience_size field will be deprecated.

Custom Broad Category Targeting

The following changes apply to custom broad category targeting for all versions:

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/broadtargetingcategories endpoint has two new fields: size_lower_bound and size_upper_bound. See also Custom Broad Category Targeting, example.

On October 27, 2021, the size field will be deprecated.

Custom Audience

The following changes apply to custom audience for all versions:

The GET /search/customaudience endpoint has two new fields: approximate_count_lower_bound and `approximate_count_upper_bound.

The GET /{act_ad-account-id}/customaudiences endpoint has two new fields: approximate_count_lower_bound and approximate_count_upper_bound.

The GET /savedaudience endpoint has two new fields: approximate_count_lower_bound and approximate_count_upper_bound.

On October 27, 2021, the approximate_count field will be deprecated.

Search

The following change applies to search for all versions:

The GET /search/adinterest endpoint has two new fields: audience_size_lower_bound and audience_size_upper_bound.

On October 27, 2021, the audience_size field will be deprecated.

Learn More

For more details, see the Facebook for Business blog and the About Estimated Audience Size, Business Help Center.
